label: mai-2
title: 〜まい
meaning_example: you probably won't die from this illness

notes.text:
This is an auxiliary which expresses the negative volition or conjecture of the speaker. It is basically a written form, used in formal writing.



For Gr. 2 verbs, Ｖmasu is occasionally used instead of Ｖinf・nonpast. For irregular verbs, すまい and こまい are sometimes used instead of するまいand くるまい, respectively. See examples #, #, and #.



まい does not have a past form. The past tense is expressed by other verbs. See examples # and #.



The volition of someone other than the speaker can be expressed by まい, as in example #. Note that と思う is used to express the volition of someone other than the speaker. Thus, example # expresses the conjecture of the speaker rather than the volition of Keiko.



Ｖinf・nonpastまいとする expresses the idea of "try not to Ｖ." See example #. When this structure is used in a subordinate clause, する is often omitted, as in example #.



ＶvolitionalかＶinf・nonpastまいか expresses the idea "whether (I) will Ｖ or not," as in example #.

notes.text:
Ｖnonpastまい

1. 行くまい (〜will not go; probably will not go)

2. 教えるまい (〜will not teach; probably will not teach)



Adj(i)stemくはあるまい

1. 高くはあるまい (〜is probably not expensive)



Adj(na)stem/Nounであるまい

1. 静かではあるまい (〜is probably not quiet)

2. 先生ではあるまい (〜is probably not a teacher)

examples.body_text:
この病気で死ぬまいと思うが、念のため医者に相談して下さい。 

		You 
		probably won't 
		die from this illness, but just in case please consult a doctor.
examples.body_html:
この病気で死ぬまいと思うが、念のため医者に相談して下さい。 
You probably won't die from this illness, but just in case please consult a doctor.

comments.text:
As for the first example, we don't say 死ぬまい for the third person. We'd say 病気で死ぬことはあるまいと思うが、…。

When you talk about yourself, you'd say この病気で死ぬまい、絶対生きてやる。

comments.text: in # what does まぬがれまい mean?
comments.html: in # what does まぬがれまい mean?

comments.text:
まぬかれる is a dictonary form. It is also pronounced as まぬがれる. 免れる means 逃れる. 

まぬがれ + まい (neg) >>> You will not be able to escape from being punished this time.
comments.html:
